scope: API cost characterization, not an optimization comparison between equal proof contracts. The new method certifies nearest-even rounding and has typed completion failures; legacy scientific formatting is an approximate presentation path.
common_rows: Eleven successful families, first and repeated queries, precision six; every string is checked in every iteration.
checked_only_rows: Unresolved zero and the original hypot return UnknownZero; a nonzero unresolved halfway case at precision five returns Exhausted. No legacy timing ratio is inferred for these rows.
order: alternating variants; all builds complete before any sample
allocation_scope: Requested Rust allocations/reallocations, retained and peak requested bytes. Allocator overhead and native heaps are excluded.
limitations: Input object construction is outside each measured query row. Constants/constructor caches can be warm. String comparison and checksum overhead are included equally. This does not measure unchanged downstream API performance or establish a hard total-work bound.
